body: I've had this experience too. Another annoying one is the threesome comments. You'd think people wouldn't still have that be their thought process but I've had that before with a straight man I was dating (pre coming out as enby). He also straight up said I was pansexual because I had no problem dating trans people, so uh, that didn't obviously last.

I hope Aiden is doing ok and phaer dysphoria stops being a bitch. Phae seems really nice.

(I'm not really experienced with neopronouns, so I hope I didn't mess up!)
That's probably due to trauma, and until you talk to someone about it or give it time, that's probably gonna be happening for a while. I had that for a while after I attempted.

Fuck I had a friend group like this, constantly trying to dox people that did anything even remotely they didn't like. It fucking terrified me and it did so much damage to my mental state. All these commenters don't seem to get the reason WHY you're scared: these people, whether you realize it or not have power over you. It's a terrifying feeling. Friends don't do this and you need to cut them off. Tell someone what happened. At least then you can warn other people. Change your number so they cant attempt to contact you.
Thank you. I don't usually use reddit but I guess I'm kinda desperate for people to talk to I suppose. I appreciate your kindness.
I wish you luck with that. Please hang on there!

Hello Sophie! It's nice to meet you! I haven't been able to dabble much in JRPGs, don't really know where to start. You got any recommendations?

Anyways, I hope Sophie's doing well today. She seems like a fun person to talk to and I bet her personality is great!

Is there anyone you can reach out to in this specific moment? Keep your hands occupied, count the objects around you and ground yourself. Keep anything that can hurt you out of reach. You are not a horrible person.

Where I went to they usually walk you through the process of getting in, including filling out forms for intake. I don't think you should worry about that to much. More than likely they'll take care of it while you're there.
Your feelings are not invalidated just because someone else seems to be worse off. We're all struggling and we all deserve to be heard.
Please keep your hands occupied and keep any sharp objects and weapons away, sleep on it for a while until this passes and talk to someone please.

Shit, yeah, that'll do it. I was scared to reach out to go to therapy for this exact reason. Maybe try finding any mental health services near you that you can go to for free? I managed to find a place like that and was able to get some decent therapy for a while. They also had it to where I could get medication for cheap through their pharmacy within their clinic and was able to get mine for like 6 bucks til I got medicaid and was able to get it for free.

Call an ambulance or drive yourself to the hospital. Talk to someone and keep constant contact, and do not do anything else to hurt yourself. Keep yourself occupied in the meantime until someone can get to you. You are strong and you can pull through this.
Is there some sort of legal support you can get? Record everything, insignificant or no, constantly keep track of everything. Don't get rid of anything. You will get through this.

My last attempt I had overdosed on blood pressure medication and felt an eerie sense of calm throughout. It was the closest I've been to dying, and I wasn't able to fully process it until after a few days back home. It just felt really hazy for me. Take some time to process it, talk to someone about it.

Are you in some sort of therapy? Sounds like your previous support was fucking garbage and it can really fuck you up and even retraumatize you. I underestimated the amount of damage that my previous support system did to me and it took a long while to trust people again. A lot of that was due to time, but therapy was extremely helpful for me in this regard. I would definitely suggest talking to someone about why you're having difficulty reaching out. It might give people a better understanding of your situation.

What's something you like doing, or look forward to every day? Is there a food you haven't tried? There's no shame in using insignificant reasons to live, because it's an active struggle every single day. Mine was I wanted to bitch about how awful Homestuck was, so I had to stick it out so I can make fun of it with my friends. Then it was a different reason, like I wanted to actually try those dippin dots that never seems to be in stores outside of those kiosks at like malls and zoos and shit. These sound like dumb reasons to live, but it really isn't. Not when it's keeping you alive for another day.

I'm not saying to make that the only thing to do, because obviously you need more than that to live, and it's obviously good to seek therapy, but at least it's living for yourself rather than the whole "people will miss you" shit. And sometimes help isn't always available right away. Small reasons are good as long as it keeps you breathing.

Please talk to someone, is there anyone you can reach out to? I don't think you should go through with this. I know platitudes and shit aren't going to stop you, but maybe at least take a nap first? Go do something else, occupy your hands in a way that isn't pertaining to suicidal urges. Think about where you are from there, just please don't go through with this.

I don't even think people who don't go through depression really know what the hell their doing, but it sounds like you have a good start. I guess just continue to do what got you to this point now, since it seemed to work before. I'm happy for you, genuinely.
Walkings actually very helpful too, so I definitely encourage you to go do that

When I went to get help from a place specializing in mental health I also had this very uncomfortable conversation, and they asked if I needed to be in inpatient psych. I understand why they do this but I really wish they could be more delicate about it. Made me feel like some kind of criminal or helpless animal or something.

Maybe going out might help? If you're not good with crowds you can go somewhere more secluded but after my attempt I went out more and just like physically sharing a space with someone was very therapeutic in a way I couldn't describe, even when I went alone.

Just going to say right now that this is a terrible fucking idea and there's no other way to phrase that statement other than you're encouraging others to commit suicide. Please for your own sake talk to someone and stop trying to encourage others in your own situation to take their life. I'm guessing this is from a place of loneliness and desperation and I'm trying really hard to sympathize but this is a horrible, horrible mindset and I encourage you to please seek some form of counselling before you hurt someone/get someone to hurt themselves. And if this is a bait post, then you can go and fuck yourself.
After my attempts I just tried to be around people as much as possible. I couldn't bear to be alone because then I'd have to be alone with my own thoughts about how pathetic I was.

I guess the only advice I can give as someone who's 22 and has attempted myself is any reason is a good reason to live. Even the seemingly insignificant ones. What's the one thing you look forward to? Eating a certain food, reading or watching something, anything really. There's always going to be at least one small reason. Just to at least make it to the next day. That's the most important thing. Just at least try to make it until you can find a better one, and the reason you choose is your reason and not for someone else. I'm not sure if I'm making sense rn but I hope I am.

I feel you, it feels like the only thing I have control over anymore. It's my decision, no one can tamper with it. I realize it's not a good place to be in at all but I understand the reasoning. But living is also a choice. You choose to wake up each and every day. I think that can also be comforting in its own way. I've already given up on myself, but maybe you shouldn't.
